verdict_scope: Narrow recheck that the original six second-batch blockers are closed by docs 30 sections 4.1/4.2 and the JSON resolution contracts.
implementation_status: not_assessed; contracts explicitly describe future prototypes, not production implementation

original_blockers.resolution: Target push uses _knock_cell row-axis semantics; blocked push uses BFS to a free four-adjacent target cell, shortest path then learner-relative cell order, first legal step only. Already adjacent means stay. Valid trigger consumes even without movement and never enters the occupied enemy cell.

One helper handles all later positive grants: source-specific synergy/item bonuses first, then strongest-lock remainder, floor, and capacity clamp. Deploy energy, costs/losses, and stolen-energy transfer/drain recovery are excluded. Expiry/replacement/death events and suppression consumption are explicit.

Non-self living in-range below-cap allies use learner-relative stable order, max two. Grants pass the lock helper and cap. No actual ally gain means no consume or delay; otherwise delay is appended after native next_act scheduling.

Mark begins after the native packet. A later positive direct _final_damage packet consumes it; DOT does not. The 1.2 multiplier is after attacker weather/synergy/item and before ult cap and final defender DR. Cap remains binding; zero/immune/dodge preserves the mark; death/replacement/expiry are explicit.

Eligibility is recorded on surviving threshold loss including sash/DOT, but effect activates only after the complete native/DOT packet if still alive and below threshold. DR joins the temporary/partner max bucket with independent expiry and affects direct damage only; DOT bypass remains. Pushes use a pre-push living-position snapshot, canonical order, and destination reservation.

Checks occur after authoritative HP loss, movement, or positive energy gain. Patient selection is lowest HP ratio then learner-relative key, excluding self. Raw missing-HP share floors before healing block. No patient/raw-zero/dead-source/low-energy leaves the machine and energy untouched; a legal positive raw heal atomically pays and consumes even if blocked to zero.

adjudicated_exceptions_confirmed: Breach Lunge intentionally does not BFS into the enemy-occupied target cell; it seeks a free four-adjacent target cell and stays if already adjacent.
Standburst intentionally activates after the complete native/DOT packet; DOT may trigger but does not receive the direct-damage DR benefit.
checks: Exactly six second-batch machines carry nonempty resolution_contract fields.
shared_resolution_contract covers distance, stable target order, packet boundary, resolution order, finite-state stacking, and future passive causes.
Docs 4.1 and JSON contracts agree on the six adjudicated semantics.
No images were opened and no source files were modified by this review.
residual_implementation_risks: Passive standburst/field-triage events still require a future cause_kind animation/event adapter; the current adapter only covers the first two native causes.
No prototype or production code was run or released by this narrow design review.
